description: openclaw-tax-image: Renovate bumps the Dockerfile FROM (tag + digest) of ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw.
Design: maxkuminov/infra docs/homelab-wave-oc.md OC-D9, OC-D10, 5.2. Overrides the org-inherited config (maxkuminov/renovate-config) for this repository.
Upstream OpenClaw base: STABLE tags only, the wave OC 5.2 regex (no betas, -N re-releases, -rDATE refreshes, variants, latest).
Plain lag behind the main gateway: the upstream tag must be one day old, PRs and merges only 9am-8pm America/New_York (OC-D10).
automerge ON since OC2 (the activation step, its own PR): Renovate merges the FROM bump itself inside the window; a hold on the main gateway switches it off again by PR (5.2).
A new digest under the SAME upstream tag means the tag moved; the digest pin exists to catch exactly that (wave OC L15). Never proposed, never merged.
Workflow action pins: a merge rebuilds and republishes the tax image (same version, higher run number), so a human merges these.
GitHub-hosted runner image: stay on ubuntu-24.04 until a deliberate choice (wave OC OC-D9); runner majors are never proposed.
